nodes.label: Treat GPP consent objects without any consent flags as invalid, fallback to server-side parsing (v1.0.78)
nodes.rationale: Some CMPs return parsed GPP consent objects that are missing all consent flags even though those flags exist in the underlying consent string. Rather than trust the malformed parsed object, the client treats such objects as invalid and falls back to server-side parsing of the raw consent string to correctly check the flags.

nodes.label: PARTNER_DATA_KEYS exported constants
nodes.rationale: Exported for IDE autocompletion when setting partnerData keys.

nodes.label: partnerData option (semantic-key partner data map)
nodes.rationale: Lets partners supply data via semantic keys (hem, phone, ua, ipv4, ipv6, url, domain, puid, idfa, gaid, idfv, etc.) instead of an encoded pd string; emails and phone numbers are auto-normalized and SHA256 hashed, MAIDs auto-lowercased, and partnerData takes precedence over pd when both are provided.
